thread:
ana_sales: Heads-up — BetaHealth POC asking for a hosted pricing exception. They want the monthly min charge waived for the 90-day pilot and a temporary per-token price of $0.00075 for generations (down from our $0.0012).

sam_ae: Timeline? do they sign any commit?

ana_sales: POC starts next Monday. No long-term commit, but potential to convert to Dedicated if numbers look good. Expected ramp: month1 ~200k tokens, month2 ~1.2M, month3 ~4–5M.

chris_dealdesk: @ana_sales need ARR or expected spend to justify override. Also: internal policy says we can do trial waivers up to 60 days without exec signoff. 90 days needs manager ok.

ana_sales: They're sensitive to upfront costs — legal won't sign if min charge applies. If we do 90-day waiver they may convert to $X/month Dedicated after.

lia_engineer: FWIW, we can tag their requests for throttling/caching to reduce cost during POC. That could keep their billed tokens lower.

pricing-bot: Policy check: hosted per-token override allowed if expected committed spend > $25k or trial <= 60 days. Exception request form: https://redwood/sales/exceptions (auto CC @chris_dealdesk).

chris_dealdesk: We need a short business case: (1) conversion probability, (2) expected 12-month ARR if converted, (3) any security blockers. If you can get BetaHealth to sign a short MOU (non-binding) for a managed pilot, we can approve a 60-day full min-waive + 30-day partial credit.

sam_ae: I can push for MOU today. BetaHealth dev lead is waiting on pricing to spin up infra.

ana_sales: Drafting MOU now. Quick Q: would a 60-day full min-waive + 30-day 50% min credit be acceptable?

chris_dealdesk: That fits policy guardrails. Approve provisionally pending MOU + expected conversion notes. I'll log the exception: request #EX-2024-998.

lia_engineer: Please include a config note for us: enable prefix caching + 128-token batching for POC; that should cut cost ~20–30% while keeping latency.

ana_sales: Great — I'll get MOU and customer commitment note today and file the exception form. Thanks all :raised_hands:

pricing-bot: Exception recorded: EX-2024-998. Decision: provisional approval (60d full min-waive + 30d 50% credit) pending MOU and conversion estimate.

chris_dealdesk: @sam_ae @ana_sales once MOU arrives I'll finalize and send a one-pager to legal for the temporary terms.

sam_ae: On it. I'll ping BetaHealth procurement now.

ana_sales: Closing loop: BetaHealth wants to spin infra tomorrow morning if we can deliver MOU + waived min. I'll update thread when signed.
